description: Marketing-side fixture manifest. Each entry maps a marketing-relevant game state to an Arc-side save fixture (or declares a gap). Arc's MANIFEST.json at ChroniclesOfNesis/WebTests/fixtures/saves/frontier/MANIFEST.json is the source of truth for what file exists; this manifest is the source of truth for what marketing wants to capture from.
